select group_concat(er.VDATE ORDER BY ea.DISPENSE_PARA separator ',') distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, er.VDATE vdate, er.MDATE mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and er.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE
